main.description: The comments on a gist, oldest first: dev.knotless.comment records whose subject is the gist's own dev.knotless.repo record, less those its owner hid, those by accounts its owner blocked, and those taken down. No authentication; asked as an account, with a service token or the pages' session cookie, the answer says what that account may do with them, and which reactions are its own.

errors.description: No such repository, or it is not a gist; or this appview keeps no index, so it knows no comments.
errors.name: NotFound

viewer.description: What the account asking may do with them; absent when no one asks.

gist.description: The gist's dev.knotless.repo record. Its authority may be a handle.

viewerState.description: What the account asking may do with what is said on a gist, past commenting, editing what it wrote and reporting, which anyone may.

hide.description: Whether it may hide a comment: as the gist's owner.

description: What was said on a gist.
